source: Clients that run JavaScript apply the patch, and clients matching {0} never stream in the first place, so they receive the full buffered {1}. Anything else (a crawler your {2} does not list, a link unfurler, {3}) will not see those tags at all. JSON-LD scripts, {4} tags and body-positioned tags are the exception: they are rendered as real markup before {5}, where every client can read them. Keep other SEO-critical tags (canonical links, social meta) synchronous, or opt the route out of streaming with {6}.
